name: FLA_INCREMENT_PERIODS_INT
description: FLA_INCREMENT_PERIODS_INT contains the payment increase agreement assessment periods information Assessment Date, Increase Percent etc.

columns.name: INTERFACE_PERIOD_ID
columns.description: Interface increment agreement period identifier. This column constitutes primary key along with LOAD_REQUEST_ID column of the table.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Oracle Enterprise Scheduler: request identifier of the interface load job that created the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: INTERFACE_LEASE_ID
columns.description: Interface Lease identifier. It references the primary key of the FLA_LEASES_INT table.

columns.name: INTERFACE_AGREEMENT_ID
columns.description: Interface increment agreement identifier.

columns.name: INCREASE_PERIOD_NUM
columns.description: Payment increase assessment period number.

columns.name: ASSESSMENT_DATE
columns.description: Date when the payment increase assessment will be performed.

columns.name: FINAL_ASSESSED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the final assessment is done or not for the assessment period.

columns.name: LAST_ASSESSED_DATE
columns.description: Indicates the last date when assessment happened for the assessment period.

columns.name: INCREASE_CALC_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Defines whether to use index based, fixed rate based, or a greater or lower value of both when calculating the increase percent.

columns.name: INCREASE_PERCENT
columns.description: Increase percent as entered by user or as calculated by system for the assessment period.

columns.name: FIXED_INCREASE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Fixed increase amount as entered by user for the assessment period.

columns.name: BASIS_FACTOR_PERCENT
columns.description: Basis factor percent as entered by user for the assessment period.

columns.name: INCREASE_APPLICABLE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the payment increase is applicable for the assessment period or not.

columns.name: DERIVED_FIXED_INCREASE_PERCENT
columns.description: Fixed increase percentage which was derived.

columns.name: ASSESSMENT_DERIVATION_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the way the missing index should be derived during assessment of an assessment period.

columns.name: INDEX_FINDER_MONTHS
columns.description: Indicates the check for index if it can span for these number of months.

columns.name: SYSTEM_ORIGIN_REFERENCE_1
columns.description: System reference column to maintain the key of source system from which lease is being imported

columns.name: SYSTEM_ORIGIN_REFERENCE_2
columns.description: System reference column to maintain the key of source system from which lease is being imported

columns.name: AMEND_ACTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Amend action type which identifies which action is being performed. Values could be INSERT and UPDATE.

columns.name: AGREEMENT_NUMBER
columns.description: Payment increase agreement number.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
